C6_PROGRESSION_TITLE_HIGH_WATER_V1.rule: A title is held once its owner count first reaches the title condition and is never revoked (user: keep once earned). Bookshelf level and villa count never fall, so the current value is the high-water mark; Library records a married high-water mark on its root, raised at marriage and by the owner backfill from current state (legacy, Q5).

C6_ARENA_CHAMPION_AVATAR_V1.rule: Each settled Arena season whose immutable settlement row marks the player Champion is one origin starting at that settlement SettledAt; the catalog 60-day duration gives its end. The champion mail item stays the source reward (user: start at settlement).

C6_COSMETIC_FORWARD_BINDINGS_V1.rule: Per Q1/Stage B answer: never earnable, never counted, never zero-claimed until the owning phase binds a typed producer and removes the entry in its own PassMap sync.
